item.title: Custom Cabinet Hardware Supply for Onitsha Furniture Factory
item.description:
Client Background

A furniture factory in Onitsha, Nigeria, producing high-quality furniture for both residential and commercial markets. They were previously sourcing cabinet hardware from Taiwan.

Challenge

The client was facing high costs and long delivery times (45 days) from their Taiwanese supplier. They needed a more cost-effective and efficient alternative without compromising on quality.

Solution

JH Hardware supplied:

  • 500+ custom cabinet handles
  • 300+ sofa metal legs
  • Direct factory pricing and faster shipping

Results

  • 35% cost reduction compared to previous supplier
  • Delivery time reduced from 45 days to just 20 days
  • Consistent product quality
  • Long-term partnership established, with monthly orders

Testimonial

“We were skeptical about switching suppliers, but JH Hardware exceeded all our expectations. The cost savings and faster delivery have made a huge difference to our business.”
